function.mechanism: Acts as a benzoate weak-acid preservative; antimicrobial efficacy is linked to benzoic acid/benzoate equilibrium in acidic foods (inferred from benzoate-class evidence and regulatory function designations).

adi.basis: Group ADI for benzoic acid and benzoates, expressed as benzoic acid; retained by EFSA in 2016

efsa.key_finding: No safety concern for genotoxicity/carcinogenicity at established ADI, but exposure estimates may exceed ADI in some infant/child scenarios.

fda.cfr_citation: 21 CFR 166.110(b)(5); 21 CFR 178.2010; no standalone calcium benzoate listing found in 21 CFR Part 184

adi.basis: Benzoates group ADI (2021): free and conjugated benzoic acid from benzoates and naturally occurring benzoic acid

concerns.summary: A 2025 systematic review of mammalian-cell studies reported frequent cytogenotoxic findings for preservatives including sodium benzoate.
Recent animal work reported ovarian/reproductive-axis disruption after sub-chronic sodium benzoate dosing.
Cell-model evidence indicates possible insulin-resistance and muscle-atrophy effects at experimental sodium benzoate exposures.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA (2016) reported no genotoxicity/carcinogenicity concern for benzoic acid/benzoates at established ADI framework.
No exact IARC classification entry was found for calcium benzoate/benzoic acid/benzoates in the retrieved monographs classification dataset snapshot.

adi_exceedance.notes: EFSA exposure modeling identified scenario-dependent exceedance of the 5 mg/kg bw/day ADI, especially in younger age groups and brand-loyal consumption patterns.

risk_assessment.rationale: Regulatory bodies maintain authorization frameworks with ADIs, but EFSA identified child-scenario ADI exceedance and recent non-clinical literature provides plausible adverse-effect signals at tested exposures.
key_factors: JECFA ADI framework maintained (updated to 0-20 mg/kg bw for benzoates)
No IARC carcinogenic classification entry for calcium benzoate
Recent non-clinical toxicity signals mainly from sodium benzoate models
